messages.body_plain:
Hi Liu,

請參考以下之說明, 有任何問題, 請再提問:

1. 在 server.R 程式碼中, 其中在 downloadHandler 之中, 修改 paste0 與 write.table 應該是OK, 記得加上 row.names=FALSE :

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-DKv135VRAbM/VUOt2Ltr8VI/AAAAAAAAJh4/CzvXOb6Okt8/s1600/write.table.png>
2. 原程式碼已做部份調整, 以利 shiny 執行, 執行結果如下:

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-CAGlPDEA0Ws/VUOuc6qG8tI/AAAAAAAAJiA/uN-tr0XI5AM/s1600/download-screen.png>
3. 執行方式如下, 請依個人路徑修改:

library(shiny)
setwd("D:/rdata")
day466880 <- read.table("shiny_Downloads/day466880.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",")
day466920 <- read.table("shiny_Downloads/day466920.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",")
runApp("shiny_Downloads")

4. 參考以下 R codes:

# title : Download file
# ui.R

shinyUI(fluidPage(

  titlePanel("資料查詢"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      helpText("時間選擇"),
      dateRangeInput("dates", label = h3("Date range")),
      checkboxGroupInput("show_vars", "Columns in city to show:",
                         choices=names(day466880),
                         selected="stno"),
      selectInput("dataset", "Choose a dataset:",

                  choices=c("d466880"="d466880","d466920"="d466920")),

      br(),
      downloadButton("downloadData", "Download")
    ),

    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(

        tabPanel("台北", dataTableOutput("mytable1")),
        tabPanel("板橋", dataTableOutput("mytable2")),

        tableOutput("table")
      )
    )
  )
))

# end

# title : Download file
# server.R

library(ggplot2)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$mytable1  <- renderDataTable({day466880[, input$show_vars, drop = FALSE]})
  output$mytable2  <- renderDataTable({day466920[, input$show_vars, drop = FALSE]})
  datasetInput <- reactive({
    switch(input$dataset,
           "d466880" = day466880[,input$show_vars],
           "d466920" = day466920[,input$show_vars]
    )})

  output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {

      paste0(input$dataset, ".csv", sep='')
      },
    content = function(file) {
      if (input$dataset == "d466880") {
        write.table(day466880, file, sep=",", row.names=FALSE)
      } else if (input$dataset == "d466920") {
        write.table(day466920, file, sep=",", row.names=FALSE)
      }
    }
  )
})
# end
###############################################

messages.body_plain:
有人試過在R中輸出標準的JSON格式嗎?
    在R中直接執行和在console上執行會有不同結果，請幫忙提供意見!

            URL_Link<-c("http://61.21.17.234/all.txt <http://61.221.174.234/trendalarm_all.txt>")
            ULink=list(Issue=Issue_Name,URL=URL_Link)
            #ULink to JSON format

messages.subject: Re: 長條圖Y軸顯示問題
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ray,

程式碼是正確可執行, 繪圖結果顯示以科學符號表示, 如果須以數值表示, 可設定 options(scipen=999), 執行完成後再設定回初值 options(scipen=0), 另可使用 aggregate 計算群組統計資料.

#####
webs <- data.frame(Protocol=gl(5,4,label=c("UDP","TCP","ARP","DNS","TLSv1.2")),                 Time=c(60000,70000,80000,80000,100000,100000,100000,250000,20,30,40,10,5000,5000,10000,10000,50000,60000,70000,70000))
# method 1
Time = with(webs,
            c( sum(Time[which(Protocol=="UDP")]),
               sum(Time[which(Protocol=="TCP")]),
               sum(Time[which(Protocol=="ARP")]),
               sum(Time[which(Protocol=="DNS")]),
               sum(Time[which(Protocol=="TLSv1.2")])))
barplot(Time, names.arg=c("UDP","TCP","ARP","DNS","TLSv1.2"), density=rep(20,5),
        main="Protocol",xlab="Protocol",ylab="Time")
# method 2
options(scipen=999)
webs.agg <- aggregate(webs$Time, list(Protocol=webs$Protocol), sum) # 290000=2.9E+05
barplot(webs.agg$x, names.arg=webs.agg$Protocol, density=rep(20,5),
        main="Protocol",xlab="Protocol",ylab="Time")
options(scipen=0) # default
##### end

messages.body_plain:
Hi Ray,

可使用 order 函數, 完整R code:

#####
webs <- data.frame(Protocol=gl(5,4,label=c("UDP","TCP","ARP","DNS","TLSv1.2")), Time=c(60000,70000,80000,80000,100000,100000,100000,250000,20,30,40,10,5000,5000,10000,10000,50000,60000,70000,70000))

webs.agg <- aggregate(webs$Time, list(Protocol=webs$Protocol), sum) # 290000=2.9E+05

webs.agg <- webs.agg[order(webs.agg$x, decreasing=TRUE),]

barplot(webs.agg$x, names.arg=webs.agg$Protocol, density=rep(20,5), main="Protocol",xlab="Protocol",ylab="Time")

##### end

messages.subject: Email database
messages.body_plain:
The marketing mantra is that the money is in the list, and this is true and has been so even before the Internet came to save the leather on the marketer's shoes. However, by now I am sure you are aware that the wealth comes from inside this list. This is where the relationship that you have with the members of your list can be found.

This relationship takes time to develop and along with generating an honest and open narrative with your list members, you have provided consistently good advice with beneficial links for free. Through this you have generated a community built upon trust and expectation.

However, if you were to buy that list, then you would need a quick return on this investment and not just to recoup the money it cost to gain these personal details.

buy mailing lists <http://www.latestdatabase.com>

When was the last time you changed your email address?

In the US, about a third of people change their details every year, this means that you cannot afford to sit on a bought mailing list for too long. An undeliverable email is akin to putting the cash straight into the bin.

Even if these people do receive your email, you could still find yourself in trouble because if they do not understand why they got the message from you then they may provide your details to their ISP, and thus you may be added to the ISPs' spam filters.

Since social media came to prominence in everyday life, there is really no need to make this mistake. Always ensure that this email campaign is a planned stage in an overall marketing campaign, perhaps even announcing that certain lucky people will be receiving a message on a specific date.
